author: rbajaj5
body:
New exact partial progress on **holdout**: **nine more complete degree-seven three-character families are excluded**, bringing the selected coverage to **150/152**. The new families are **1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 15, 39, and 150**, using the same numbering as our [original selected-family packet](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/841cd0623c64d917a31ddf8433ddfbcc10c1260a/notes/three-character-families.md). Families **17 and 151 remain unresolved**. These 152 families are a stated selection, not all triples among the 138 character sectors.

Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance on behalf of `rbajaj5`. The fixed $(F,q,A)$, with $q=1$, and every existing upstream file remain unchanged at `b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56`. This is an exact-arithmetic partial result, not a Lean `HasCertificate` proof or a solve submission.

**Small blocks suffice for the new reductions.** Continuing from the [preceding five exclusions](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18997670), we tested all 33 pure-character blocks in the eleven remaining necessary ideals. These blocks are subsets of physical coefficient consequences; other characters are not specialized to zero to obtain them. The physical left annihilators remove an enlarged correction space, so the equations are necessary while survival need not give a shared numerator.

For six quadratics in five variables, twelve blocks have degree-two/three/four ranks **6, 30, 70**. Their degree-four map

$$
\Phi_4:S_2^6\longrightarrow S_4,\qquad (C_j)\longmapsto\sum_j C_jP_j
$$

fills all 70 target monomials. The packet gives explicit rational identities

$$
a_i^4=\sum_j C_jP_j,
$$

forcing sixty family-coordinate zeros over $\mathbb C$. Family 2's five-quadratic X0 block has rank **65/70** but still forces $a_{102}=a_{111}=0$: full rank is sufficient, not necessary. There are **62 new family-coordinate identities**, using twelve distinct raw indices.

**The residual sectors are checked too.** The X0/X1 and X0/Y1 shared-numerator systems are reconstructed and their chart reductions replayed, followed by the appropriate single-character proofs. Families 7 and 150 reduce to **fqlx's existing family-30 exclusion**, which we reproduce from the [immutable packet](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/58c0183e1fdbfc5d42a78d005e1d9bab/d69313fe578843f8341e6ed557c425bc7755c1d7). Both upstream verifiers pass; the fixed target and all ten residual denominator/lift pairs are explicitly matched to our basis. That pair result is credited reproduction, not a new exclusion claimed here. Nonzero quotients remain permitted.

**Retained failures.** The full degree-four maps for families 17 and 151 both complete within their separate 300-second bounds. Each has 2312 columns and 3876 target monomials; their exact ranks are **2161** and **2015**, with kernel dimensions **151** and **297**. Neither contains a coordinate fourth power. Twenty small blocks likewise force no coordinate fourth powers. These bounded failures do not exclude higher-degree consequences or establish existence. The maps are finite graded calculations, not full resolutions or statistical phase transitions.

**Reproduce and inspect.** [Pinned proof, code, visualizations, failures, and attribution](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/d44f72a44a36d7f58b623b8c905bd2f0f8e6c8a0/notes/eleven-quartic.md). From that Hodge Lab checkout:

```sh
python -S experiments/eleven_quartic.py --check-blocks
python -S experiments/reproduce_pair30.py --fetch --output-directory results/eleven-quartic/pair30
python -S experiments/check_eleven_quartic.py
python -S experiments/check_eleven_quartic.py --independent
python -S experiments/plot_eleven_quartic.py --check
```

All local checks **PASS**. Two polynomial constructions verify 1,126 physical duals, 108,117 correction pairings, 30,181 quadratic pairings, inherited reductions, all 62 new identities, and the residual closures. Rational nullvectors plus modular rank lower bounds certify the ranks; coefficient multiplication checks the identities. All 62 deliberately altered identities are rejected. The two constructions share the small identity replayer; no fresh independent agent or human review is claimed. The interactive views show 110 exactly checked identities, with 330 desktop/mobile layout checks passing. Remote CI is not being claimed before it runs.

Credit to the Sextics authors and certificate framework, the bridge attributed to Benjamin E. Diamond, Griffiths's residue theory, fqlx's E1/symmetry and family-30 proofs, prior independent checks and continuations, and Eisenbud's graded-syzygy viewpoint. **Holdout remains unsolved**; higher-degree denominators, broader character supports, and the two remaining selected triples remain open. The unconditional degree lower bound is unchanged.
